_readme: Second own-site map read at West Los Angeles College (S346, SkyCairn). Its mapper (programmap.wlac.edu) answered 403 on 2026-10-08 (S344). A domain search (2026-10-08) found the Computer Science division's FAQ page, which links 'roadmaps' for three computer science and information technology tracks; the pilot's Computer Network & Security Management (17111) may be one. This read loads the FAQ page, prints its roadmap links, and follows them where they stay off the mapper host.

questions.map_source: Where the college publishes a program's term-by-term map, and in what form (a page, a PDF, an interactive tool).
questions.map_shape: How one map names its terms and lists its courses.
